regions.finding: Sixteen independent optimization rows were retained with staged t-BuOK/Et3B/allenylation operations, row bases and loadings, solvent/volume, allene leaving group/loading, scale, NMR yields, NMR recoveries, and entry-16 isolated yield. Footnote reagents are participants.

regions.region: page 3 upper-right Table 2 header, entries 1–7, and footnotes
regions.finding: Seven distinct indole-scope experiments were retained with the shared 1 mmol, 1.5 equiv 2d, 1.1 equiv t-BuOK, 2 equiv Et3B, Pd/DPEphos, 5 mL DCM, staged room-temperature timing, and isolated yields.
Five additional substrate-scope experiments were retained separately: 3i 77%, 3j 90%, 3k 92%, 3l 86%, and ketal-containing 3m 88%. The three n-series rows are not merged despite sharing a drawing.

Product SMILES remain null where the compact fused structures were not encoded confidently.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Scheme 1 arrows for 1n and 1o
regions.finding: The ketone-containing 1n experiment gives impure 3n in 27% with 34% NMR recovery of 1n. The distinct tetracyclic 1o sequence uses a 48 h allenylation then Na(BH3)CN in MeOH/AcOH at room temperature for 3 h, giving cis-4 in 73% over the displayed sequence.
A separate 6 mmol 1j run affords 1.2813 g 3j in 96% isolated yield; it is not merged with the 1 mmol/90% scope experiment.

regions.region: page 4 lower-left Scheme 2 four synthetic-application arrows
regions.finding: Four independent 0.5 mmol 3j transformations were retained: borylcupration to 5 (33%), staged -10 °C/room-temperature MeLi reaction to cis-6 (68%), cobalt hydrosilylation to 7 (59%), and acetyl-chloride transformation to 8 (84%). All displayed additives/loadings are participants.
Conclusions add no experiment. The acknowledgment that Weiyi Wang reproduced 3h lacks independent run details and creates no duplicate. Bibliography was not expanded into current-paper experiments.

unresolved: The 27% 3n yield basis and impurity identity are not reported.
The cis-4 73% is displayed after a two-stage sequence; no 3o stage yield is printed.
Synthetic-application yield bases, solvent volumes, workups, purifications, masses, and numeric selectivities are mostly absent.
